martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, perfect running conditions around 19:00–21:00 with a comfortable 18°C and calm wind, so maybe drag Britt along for a sunset run. The rest of the day isn't as ideal, but that evening window is hard to beat. Don't forget the sunscreen, though, with that high UV index.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, running's looking great today, especially between 19:00–21:00 when it cools down to a comfy 18°C. Might be a good chance to drag Martha along for a sunset run. The wind's moderate, but it's not going to spoil the fun, and with a high UV of 6, don't forget the sunscreen.
